Definition: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
BiblicalUsage: 1) to judge, contend, plead; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to act as judge, minister judgment; 1a2) to plead a cause; 1a3) to execute judgment, requite, vindicate; 1a4) to govern; 1a5) to contend, strive; 1b) (Niphal) to be at strife, quarrel
